review: The primary reader inspected the whole page and both overlapping halves, eleven broad enlarged blocks, thirty-five focused details at 6–9×, the two further A forms and top map, and the left note unrotated and clockwise 29°, 22° and 32°. Every agreed line, C doubt, C/H difference, formula, cancellation, insertion, margin and diagram was checked against the ink. Coordinates below refer to the original 1725×2229 image; broad crops were 3–5×. The 32° view follows the steep formula baseline in the lower left note. No context was opened.
